4875-7507-7874-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4875-7507-7874-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

751-955-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-4247-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

539-2292-3821-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-2292-3821-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat

4613-4687-7308.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4687-7308.notablePrerequisites: Mona Lisa has a +1/+1 counter on it and has power 3 or greater.
4613-4687-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Mona Lisa using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

2438-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2438-5254-6627.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

401-3944-6578-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-6578-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Sephiroth trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6006-6920--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6006-6920--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

728-1405-2923.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
728-1405-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

5617-6553-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1429-2981-3545.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

757-4221-5087-6995.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-4221-5087-6995.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Lulu to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Living Plane, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

618-3305-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

628-5686-7865.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

38-5220-7855.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Skirk Prospector from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Cast Skirk Prospector from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

1580-4871-4976-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1253-3457-7791.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Gyre Engineer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Gyre Engineer.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4478-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

4872-5144-6991.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Donnie & April and exiling Ephemerate.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-1563-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

457-2797-5491-6291.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's fourth ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Thopter, creating a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token, a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability three times by tapping the Thopter, Construct and Map, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4050-5086-5183-6753-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6753-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

997-5010-5708-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2797-3053-3918.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
2797-3053-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Retrofitter Foundry's ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2797-3053-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Retrofitter Foundry's other abilities via Trazyn.

465-618-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

225-4094-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
225-4094-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sicknes.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-4094-5702-5954.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2617-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
2034-2617-4613-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of another nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2617-4613-5917.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens.

3644-3693-4613.notablePrerequisites: Young Wolf has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3644-3693-4613.description:
Activate Young Wolf using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 until Young Wolf has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Young Wolf abilities dealing 1 damage to Young Wolf, and any remaining damage to any target(s).
Young Wolf dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Young Wolf's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Wormfang Drake

372-465-4089.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Glasspool Mimic until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Glasspool Mimic from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Wormfang Drake.
Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

409-4797-4872.notablePrerequisites: Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
409-4797-4872.description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

1624-3591.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 until you have one life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

1183-1628-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Pentavus.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-1628-4050.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {1}.
The Pentavite dies, triggering Pentavus, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

2103-3554-5273.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Diabolic Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Diabolic Tutor and Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
